title: Mid-Level MLOps Engineer
description: Mid-level MLOps engineering position focused on building production ML pipelines (Kubeflow/Flyte), Feast feature store materialization, model serving platforms (KServe/Ray Serve/vLLM), Canary deployments, drift observability, and Spot training orchestration.

skills.rationale: Developing type-safe Flyte workflows, Argo templates, and managing GPU node affinities.
Operating high-throughput inference engines (vLLM, Ray Serve), KServe, and Istio Canary traffic splitting.
Designing Champion-Challenger validation gates, automated Continuous Training, and health probe rollbacks.
Executing point-in-time correct historical joins in Feast and materializing low-latency online Redis stores.
Provisioning remote MLflow tracking architectures and packaging custom PyFunc models.
Tracking prediction distribution drift, NannyML performance estimation, and Alertmanager incident routing.
Deploying BentoML services, Triton repository structures, and Trivy security scanning.
Provisioning Kubernetes ML infrastructure with Terraform, mounting FSx storage, and namespace isolation.
Configuring GPU time-slicing sharing, Spot instance automated checkpointing, and Kubecost allocation.
Enforcing full data-to-binary lineage, approval workflows, and automated bias compliance gates.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.description: Lacks production Kubernetes inference or pipeline orchestration experience.

partially_ready.description: Competent with standalone pipelines but needs guidance on Canary rollouts and GPU scaling.

ready.description: Fully autonomous MLOps engineer delivering scalable ML pipelines, robust inference platforms, and drift monitoring.

exceeds.description: Demonstrates advanced technical leadership in GPU FinOps, Karpenter autoscaling, and enterprise platform design.
